sequential_dependency.intermediate: An input-derived source-color dictionary of template offsets and target colors, plus the merged layout.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Decode source-color templates, the overlaid middle layout and bottom recolor legend.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Rotate recovered offsets clockwise in the alternative setting and stamp the selected recolored template at every occupied layout cell.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The input-specific offsets, correspondence and layout determine which output pixels exist; solid tiles cannot substitute for extraction.
